name: circle-carousel-1
title: Growing circle carousel
description: Square covers sit on a ring that grows from tiny to large as it turns.

props.name: images
props.doc: Pictures, as paths under public/ (or full URLs). They repeat when there are fewer than the count.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many covers sit on the ring.

props.name: radius
props.doc: Radius of the ring in px at the start of the shot.

props.name: minSize
props.doc: Side of the smallest cover, in px.

props.name: maxSize
props.doc: Side of the largest cover, in px.

props.name: growth
props.doc: How late the covers grow: 1 is even, higher keeps them small longer and piles the big ones up at the end.

props.name: turns
props.doc: How far the ring turns over the shot, in full turns.

props.name: startAngle
props.doc: Where the smallest cover sits, in degrees clockwise from the top.

props.name: turnStart
props.doc: Frame the ring starts turning.

props.name: turnFrames
props.doc: Frames the turn takes, eased in and out.

props.name: stagger
props.doc: Frames between one cover appearing and the next, round the ring.

props.name: push
props.doc: How far the camera pushes into the biggest cover at the end (0.5 is 50 percent past the ring shot).

props.name: rideZoom
props.doc: Zoom of the opening shot on the smallest covers.

props.name: motionBlur
props.doc: Camera motion blur shutter in frames, used while the camera moves fast. 0 turns it off.

props.name: title
props.doc: Small title at the bottom left. Empty for none.

props.name: caption
props.doc: Smaller line under the title. Empty for none.

props.name: font
props.doc: Google Fonts family for the label.

props.name: colors.ground
props.doc: Background.

props.name: colors.ink
props.doc: Title.

props.name: colors.muted
props.doc: Caption.
